name: Go Detox Mix
headline: Go Detox Mix — 16 packets
description: Psyllium, kaolin, citrus bioflavonoids and prune powder in a drinkable mix — gentle cleansing and digestive support during the program's active elimination stage.
howToUse: Mix one pouch into a glass of water or unsweetened juice, drink immediately, then follow with a glass of water. Take 4 times a day, about every 3.5 hours.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place at a temperature not exceeding 25°C. Keep out of reach of children.
manufacturing.ingredients: Psyllium husk, kaolin, citrus bioflavonoids, prune powder — 16 pouches.

fullDescription:
Go Detox Powder is used during Phase 2 of the Go Detox program. It provides gentle cleansing and digestive support to help maintain digestive balance and overall well-being. The formula combines soluble plant fibers, mineral ingredients, and citrus bioflavonoids to support comfortable digestion and regularity.*

Active Components and Their Roles

Psyllium (Plantain seed husk)

A source of soluble plant fiber that supports healthy digestion, promotes regularity, and helps maintain normal intestinal function.*

Kaolin

A naturally occurring mineral known for its gentle binding properties that support digestive comfort and a feeling of lightness.*

Citrus Bioflavonoids

Provide antioxidant support and work alongside plant fibers to help maintain digestive balance.*

Prune Powder

Gently supports regularity and promotes digestive comfort.*
